question: At what intermediate intervention width is the bounded covering estimator certified to use fewer exact oracle samples than the frozen exhaustive observational estimator?

hypotheses.prediction: Every stratum has a certified crossover width or an honest lower-upper bracket ending at the sealed v0.2 anchor.
hypotheses.falsifier: A witness, lower bound, exact cost, cell classification, or minimum-width bracket fails independent replay.

model.code_hash: bound by prospective registration before claim-grid execution
model.update_order: lexicographic candidate enumeration, deterministic maximum-gain selection, reverse deletion, then exact query-count enumeration
model.rng: none; the experiment and all tie breaks are deterministic

changes.block_size: every integer strictly between k and the sealed high-width anchor

seed_plan.pairing: No RNG exists; labels identify disjoint design roles rather than stochastic seeds.

denominators.sample_cost: fresh oracle draws per queried intervention block

exposure.activation: a selected s-block contains the support
exposure.state_change: the support is marked covered by the incumbent witness

analysis.uncertainty: deterministic certified interval [L,U], not sampling uncertainty
analysis.multiple_comparisons: all grid cells are reported; no winner selection or pooled p-value
analysis.stopping_rule: 4096 deterministic greedy rounds per cell or the frozen operational wall/resource ceiling; retain valid incumbent and lower bound on stop

budget.execution: sequential deterministic covering cells; no GPU and no parallel solver state

artifacts.seed_manifest: experiment_v0_2_1.json (deterministic design roles; no RNG seeds)

width_rule.3: every integer s with 3 < s < n-3
width_rule.4: every integer s with 4 < s < n-2
